title: Plumeform section heading (v2)
description: A widely spaced capital eyebrow, a tight heavy heading (72px page title or 48px section title on desktop) and an optional slate lead paragraph, left-aligned or centred. Reveals on scroll.
notes: the title accepts inline nodes, e.g. a badge after the last word
name: plumeform-v2-heading

props.name: body
props.description: a lead paragraph under the title

props.name: size
props.description: page: the 60–72px page title (h1); section: 36–48px (h2); card: 30–36px (h3)
